description: Watches the International Space Station and files the passes worth stepping outside for.
name: sky_watcher

signals.description: The ISS entered the approach corridor around the observer; a pass is under way, whether or not this one will be visible.
signals.name: station_approaching

signals.description: A sunlit ISS pass over a dark sky begins within the lead time, culminating above the visible minimum elevation.
signals.name: visible_pass_starting

signals.description: A near-zenith visible ISS pass: culmination at or above the bright threshold. Rare, and the one worth waking for.
signals.name: bright_pass
